searchText: Hi everyone, super excited to join this channel. Hello all, This is Satyajit. Very happy to be part of this and looking forward to learning and contributing! 🙂 Hello hello! Hello everyone, glad to be here. I will be working on the problems on the ethereum economic model side. Happy to collaborate with anyone who shares the same interest. Hi everyone! I'm also a permissionless participant with a background in systems programming. I've been running Rocket Pool nodes since the beginning (check them out if you're can, it's an amazing community) but wanted to start contributing on the Ethereum protocol side of things, so here I am! When is the first meeting? We will be hosting the first meeting Oct 25th. https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-three/issues/14 Great to see more econ guys Can permissionless fellows update their progress on the Github repo? Yes, we encourage anyone participating in the program to use the repo to update your progress. What would be the main difference between permissionless and permissoned fellows? Is it the mentor support? I think it's mainly the stipend (please correct if wrong) I think another difference might be enhanced support in terms of placement after successfully finishing the program. We will do our best to support any participant that is doing good work to continue that work after the program is over.
